notes.title: New Updates to the game. v1.0.0.24 is live
notes.content:
Hi All,

Thank you for your continuous support for Brocula. The game is improving every day, and I'm excited to share some new updates that I've added for the first time with myself in mind. Let's dive into these changes.

[h2]Difficulty Level[/h2]

While Brocula has many cozy elements, I wanted to introduce some challenges. Therefore, I'm adding difficulty levels to the settings. Having played this game for a few years, I can quickly make coffee items and often find myself waiting for 15-30 seconds at the coffee shop, as well as in the garage and restaurant. The new difficulty levels address this wait time.

By default, the difficulty level is set to EASY, so if you're enjoying the current settings, nothing will change for you. However, if you'd like a more challenging experience:
[list]
[*] [b]MEDIUM[/b]: Customer wait time decreases by 1/3, and the number of customers doubles.
[*] [b]HARD[/b]: Customer wait time decreases by 2/3, and the number of customers triples.
[/list]

These adjustments keep the part-time job sections fresh and engaging for experienced players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221030/d8ffb974b0a3da658701a380a3020992c28a29bc.png[/img]

[h2]Weather System[/h2]

I'm also implementing a weather system, starting with Rain mode, as we're approaching monsoon season here in India. Every few days in the game, you'll now experience rainfall throughout the city. You can control the rain volume in the settings menu to suit your preferences.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221030/74375bc45251cbecc45f71b523098acd3f5103c0.gif[/img]


[h2]Minor Bug Fixes[/h2]

Regular bug fixes include:
1. Fixed a translation issue in the library where a character was missing translations.
2. Fixed a bug with the farmer not accepting box deliveries after playing for more than 5 hours continuously.

I hope these updates enhance your gaming experience. Looking forward to your feedback on these changes.

Thank you once again for your support.

Prateek / Destroyer Doggo

notes.title: Brocula v1.0.0.23 is Live and here are the patch notes
notes.content:
First of all thank you to some amazing people who were kind enough to jump on discord and talk to me about the bugs and give out valuable suggestions. 

This patch is primarily to fix some minor issues and add 1-2 new features. Here is the detailed list of things are in this new patch/version of the game:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where in all stores where when you press up or down more times than there are items, the other items all move to the right.
[*] Increased the space between the fence and the constructed items outside the castle.
[*] Fixed a bug where you have to go out of the collider zone to collect mud again.
[*] Items now have a white outline to tell the player what is selected for better visual indication
[*] You can now delete a placed object. 
[*] Fixed zero items in player inventory.
[*] Adding Discord QR code for easy access to the community
[*] Fixed a bug in the trunk where last item from player inventory would not update the view.
[*] Fixed consumption quantity in Church Table deposit where Bread and Juice were being consumed more that required. 
[*] Player created trunks can now use be opened with single key press instead of Hold.
[*] Fixed translation issue for Library buy shop
[*] Players now have the ability to create trunks in the mines. 
[*] Fixed a bug where player crafted trunk would lose item information. 
[*] Fixed Inventory item mismatch on pause screen issue. This issue refers to the part where when a player looks at their inventory and they see the next item from the list. 
[/list]

I hope these fixes will make the game better for the players. Thank you once again for all the feedback for the game. 

Prateek / Destroyer Doggo

notes.title: Brocula v1.0.0.17 is live and here are the patch notes
notes.content:
Woah , so many negative reviews. I wont lie that It does sting a little bit, but tbh it was totally my fault for not testing the game thoroughly. And I am gonna make up for it. 

I have been listening to your feedback for past few days and been making changes accordingly. 

I am updating the game with following changes as per the feedback. 

- [list]
[*] - More time in a Day. Day-Night cycle has been changed from 10 min cycle to 15  min cycle. 
[*] - NPCs now reach their day destination faster, especially when the player is asleep.
[*] - Fixed an issue where NPC don’t even get out of their homes if save time is close to start of the day.
[*] - Ability to get out of soft locks. A few people notified that they were stuck with crafting menu while running. You can now close this menu with the back button. 
[*] - Fixed a bug where street and building lights do not work as intended. 
[*] - Overall stamina consumption time is reduced to 1.5 seconds from 1 second.
[*] - Placing a new object outside the castle is more fluid now.
[*] - Fixed a bug where Writing table was generating blue diamonds outside of interaction zone.
[*] - Everchanging forest exit is now fixed. Also reduced the complexity of the forest for better gameplay.
[*] - Trunk now has information about the selected item, space per item, and whether it can be used to increase stamina and health
[*] - Inventory now has information about space required per item.
[*] - You don’t need to hold in Garage anymore to get items
[*] - No more pressing hold to chop down trees, break rocks, pickup stones, mud, berries or mushrooms.
[*] - No more hold for trunk transfers anymore  (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻
[*] - No more hold for Dumpster either. 
[*] - No more hold button for sleeping either. PEOPLE SAID NO MORE HOLDS!!!
[*] - Adding back mouse cursor. 
[*] - Increased Health of Fishing Rod so that it can be used for more number of times.
[*] - Updated Fishing Mechanics for easy fishing.
[*] - Increased Bird attack timeout on crops from 400 seconds to 1800 seconds, no more bat complaining about crops getting destroyed.
[*] - Reduced Egg cooking time from 60 seconds to 10 seconds. Eggulaaa FTW!!
[*] - Fixed start up noise from Tutorial Indicators (so annoying) 
[*] - Some more minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Whats coming next in the next build. 

[list]
[*] Volume control for Walking sounds
[*] Volume control for Bird sfx
[/list]

Thank you once again for all the feedback. 
Prateek / Destroyer Doggo

notes.title: Final_final_(r)elease_final.game
notes.content:
Hi All

Thank you so much for being patient while I had that PC mishap last month. I have been extremely busy fixing bugs and updating code for the release. And today is a good day to announce a few things.

[h1]Destroyer Doggo at ID@Xbox Digital Sessions[/h1]

On March 26, 2024, I (Prateek Jadhwani) had an opportunity to talk about Brocula at the ID@Xbox Digital Sessions organised by XBox. This event was hosted by Jun Shen Chia, from the Xbox Global Expansion Team to show their support for independent developers and their upcoming games who are a part of ID@Xbox program.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221030/324217d75451d75393b1b945f49c3b8fc8051c32.jpg[/img]

And because of this event, there were also a lot of news articles. IGN India was kind enough to give their article about this event along with the official XBox Wire article.

[url=https://in.ign.com/brocula/204514/news/idxbox-indian-game-brocula-among-featured-titles-in-the-latest-showcase-episode][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221030/d30f3d77828eb10360e3c2191434c8b8ec93b866.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://news.xbox.com/ja-jp/2024/04/02/idxbox-digital-sessions-recap/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221030/d259b0764204060749209af01d94bfebf192afc5.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Demo Updates[/h1]

After months of delay, and feedback, I have now updated the demo to version 1.5.0.x. There are a few changes in this update. One of the major updates is the performance. As you might have seen from my earlier posts, I wanted the game to run smoothly on older computers as well. And now it can do that. It even runs smoothly on steam deck, which was earlier an issue.

If you are someone who is interested in the game, but don’t want to buy it yet, feel free to give this version of demo a try again. 

[h1]Xbox Certification [/h1]

After months of porting efforts, I am happy to announce that the most recent build of Brocula passed XBox certification guidelines. This was a major hurdle that I needed to clear in order to launch the game on XBox. 

With this certification, the demo build is also available on XBox. Here is the link to the demo, if you would like to give it a try.

https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/brocula-demo/9p6qbwdw9jcp 

Or if you would like to Wishlist the XBox version of the main game, here is the link:

https://www.xbox.com/en-in/games/store/brocula/9pmrpwfm01jf 

[h1]22k Wishlists[/h1]

This is mind blowing. I never imagined that so many people would be interested in this small game of mine. Thank you all who have wishlisted the game and are looking forward to the release. Which brings me to the next topic at hand.

[h1]Release Dates[/h1]

Finally, the section you all have been waiting for. After a lot of thinking and testing, I have decided that the release date of this game should be as follows: 

1. XBox: [b]7th May[/b]
2. Steam: [b]9th May[/b]

This date is not too close for me to not fix any last minute bugs and not too far that we all forget about the release. 

If you are an influencer or from the Press, please feel free to request a review copy on [url=https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/60fecb13]KeyMailer[/url] for your favourite platform (XBox or Steam). Keys will be released on 1st of May, so you will have 1 whole week to play in advance.

Lastly, thank you all who have been a part of this journey. From making the first prototype of this game to finally releasing the game, this has been a long and emotional journey. I thank everyone who have been a part of this journey, and for all the love and support. 

Best of Luck fellow Vampires, 
Prateek Jadhwani

notes.title: Game Updates - Jan 2024
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! Hope you all are having a good January! I have a few updates regarding the game and its future. So here it goes. 

[h2]Destroyer Doggo[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221030/2644c331387c1eaf05d915f085ef2b2b0ebb0750.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221030/2c17e710d01f9d7b8625af9e6786a0ece7cc5c54.png[/img][/url]

Last year, Brocula was lucky enough to receive a grant from [url=https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2023/03/21/id-xbox-developer-acceleration-program-underrepresented-creators/]XBox under the Developer Acceleration Program[/url]. This grant has help me as a developer to quit my day job and start my own game dev studio under the name [url=https://www.linkedin.com/company/destroyer-doggo/?viewAsMember=true]Destroyer Doggo[/url]. I can finally remove my personal name from the Developer and Publisher section and replace it with Destroyer Doggo. 

[h2]New Gameplay Video[/h2]

I finally had some time to record a new gameplay video and put it on youtube. This video is recorded after 30 hours of speed run. And no, I have not finished the gameplay yet.

[previewyoutube=3vfIrI3yEzs;full][/previewyoutube]

I am also uploading the video to steam store page for easier access. You can see the video either here or on the Brocula Store page.

[h2]12K Wishlists[/h2]

Brocula recently participated in Capitalism and Economy Fest. Steam was kind enough to help the game with its wishlists, and we have now 12k+ in wishlists. For a small indie game, wishlists matter a lot in determining its success. And you guys made it happen. I would like to thank you all for this achievement. 

[h2]Demo Updates[/h2]

I have been listening to your feedback. A lot of people have told me how the farming mechanics are a little janky. I am updating the farming mechanics to be more responsive. I am hoping people will like it now. 

Church is also an important part of the core gameplay loop. Updating the amount of people helps the player get more Blood of Faith for other purposes. And I have added a new probability calculation that will help player get more blood out of people. 

These updates will be pushed out to people in the coming days. Your feedback matters alot to me. Thank you so much for all the help and support. 

[h2]XBox Porting Update[/h2]

Few days ago I posted [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/F5931wlZrXY?si=JpUiJ70jZlzd6_6e]video of Brocula running on the XBox Dev Kit[/url]. This was the first build to ever run on the Xbox. While I do need to test it more, it is still progress. I received a lot of help from [url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/akshat-puri-430407201/]Akshat[/url], from the Indian Gamedev Community, to help me understand the porting process. 

[h2]Videos of People playing the game[/h2]

I love it when people play Brocula. So here are recent videos on Brocula I found.

notes.title: Game Delayed and I am Sad
notes.content:
As a solo dev, sometimes testing can take a lot of time., especially if the game takes more than 40 hours to complete. Yesterday I found a few game breaking bugs towards the later part of the game. This means One of the NPCs not working as expected, and achievement system being broken. Fixing and testing those bugs will take me 1-2 weeks, which will make me miss the certification date (this is a part of the Steam process). 

Missing the release date for Steam will also push the game closer to the Xbox release date, which is why I am now planning to release both on Xbox and Steam, which should be around End of Feb or Early March. For some people, this news is going to be disappointing. I understand that. A lot of people make their schedule around release of a game, including me. I would like to apologize for the delay. But I would like to give this community a good game in working condition than a broken game. 

As for the new release date, I will be updating this community in the coming days. 

- Prateek

notes.title: Demo 1.2 is out now!
notes.content:
It is not even second week, and I am already writing my third post of this year. As you might have guessed from the title of this post, I am updating the demo to a newer version, that means bug fixes!!! So without wasting any more time, let’s get on to the major change in this version. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221030/8677f5a4ed6272ce46f76e4c1f9c68846cd102b3.png[/img]

[h2]Spanish Localisation[/h2]

To be honest, Spanish localisation was not part of my initial release. I wanted to wait for a few months, see if there was anyone who was interested in the Spanish version. But thankfully [url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/javier-argueso/]Javier Argüeso[/url] reached out to me and was kind enough to offer his services of Spanish translations for the game. Because of him and his fast translations, we will now be able to play Brocula in Spanish as well. If you are one of those cool people, who like to play games in Spanish, please feel free to thank him. And if you a game developer or a studio looking for Spanish translations, you can always hire [url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/javier-argueso/]Javier[/url].

[h2]Other Minor changes[/h2]

Thank you all the people who have reached out to me on Discord and Steam Community to provide feedback. Here are the list of changes that are happening because of your feedback. 

[list]
[*] Fixed localisation on Map
[*] Added Church on the Map
[*] Sucking blood from people can be done from all sides now, making it more fluid
[*] Farming Changes - Harvesting uses different key than Sowing.
[*] Fixed Work button auto pressed bug
[/list]

[h2]Other News[/h2]

This section is going to be an interesting one. Over the past few weeks I have been seeing videos about Brocula popping up on the internet. I just wanted to give a shout out to the people who were kind enough to make videos about it. Thank you so much for the help and support. 

Apologies if I have missed out any of the videos, please feel free to ping me, I will add it next time I have some thing to announce.

notes.title: Brocula December Updates and Release Date
notes.content:
Hey Guys!! Hope you all are doing good. 
I just wanted to updated you all on a few things regarding Brocula before holidays starts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221030/15f8651139dd4f84f70bf140c6caa96e4fd1adc7.gif[/img]

[h2]Game Progress[/h2]
[olist]
[*] I wanted the first 15 min of the game to be tutorial driven, as in even if a player does not read dialogues, the markers on the screen will tell the player where to go and what to do.
[*] No more frame rate drop issues. I had to take a step back and re-write some of the code. (Thank you Surya for the insights on how to do that)
[*] Localization plays an important role in the experience. The game is now localized in English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Brazilian-Portuguese, Japanese and Russian. If you want the game to be localized in a language, feel free to let me know.
[*] I also have a 9+ gameplay video that covers some of the tutorial screens. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TiqKA45fVHw&ab_channel=PrateekJadhwani]Watch Gameplay Video[/url]
[*] Since the game is going to be launched in XBox as well, we have an XBox store page as well : [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-in/games/store/brocula/9pmrpwfm01jf]Brocula on XBox[/url]
[*] The game release date is set to [b]1st Feb 2024[/b]. So feel free to tell your friends and family :)
[/olist]

[h2]Upcoming Updates[/h2]
[olist]
[*] I will be updating the demo with the above mentioned updates in a new build by end of Dec
[*] I recently received my XBox dev kit. So, the porting process will start now. 
[*] More testing. I do want to get 100% achievement in the game, so I will be playing and testing the game even more in the coming days.
[/olist]

[h2]Regular Updates[/h2]
While I use Steam for showing major updates, you can always follow the game on other social media platforms to stay updates or just to show support.
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/broculagame]Follow On Instagram[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/broculagame]Like on Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/pjbrocula]Create a cult on Reddit[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/KFf3Q92MtJ]Say Hi on Discord[/url]
[/list]

Thank you once again for all the help and support. 
Happy Holidays! 

- Prateek

notes.title: Demo version 0.3 is out now!!
notes.content:
Over the past one month, I have seen a lot of people play Brocula's demo. And this update is for them. Thank You for all the feedback at IGDC, Discord Playtests, and Youtube videos. Your feedback has helped me with fixing a lot of bugs and making the demo even better. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38221030/43d42f0dd8a579e88151a7d62cea2576f0427eda.jpg[/img]

Here are some of the changes in the demo that will help it make a better experience. 

[list]
[*] Added Waypoints for better navigation in the town
[*] Added controller prompt to tell the player how to run and use map
[*] Converted tasks into a much more linear gameplay
[*] Coffee shop tutorials now tell the player where to go, and added ability to skip steps if the player is familiar with the gameplay
[*] Bug fixes for colliders, now player doesnt have to go back and forth to activate crafting menu
[*] Fixed a soft lock that used to happen when player is triggering crafting menu while running
[*] New transfer menu for better readability
[*] Improvements in fishing. 
[*] Players can now throw chicken into the pond. (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻
[/list]

But as always, i am listening to your feedback. Thank you for playing Brocula.
